title: Anthropic's $35B cloud deal with Lambda adds new layer to circular financing concerns
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Lambda 达成的 350 亿美元云协议为循环融资担忧增添了新的一层
summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) has signed a $35 billion cloud deal with Lambda (LAMD.PVT), according to Wall Street Journal reporting. Lambda is backed by Nvidia (NVDA).
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 已与 Lambda (LAMD.PVT) 签署了价值 350 亿美元的云协议。 Lambda 由 Nvidia (NVDA) 支持。

title: John Ternus's first day as Apple CEO, JOLTS data, Dell earnings: What to Watch
title_zh: 约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 就任苹果首席执行官的第一天、JOLTS 数据、戴尔财报：看点
summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Tuesday, Sept.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 仔细研究了 9 月 12 日星期二投资者关注的头条新闻。

title: Alphabet stock has tanked recently because of a 'brain drain'
title_zh: Alphabet 股价最近因“人才流失”而暴跌
summary: Alphabet has had a rough run.
summary_zh: Alphabet 经历了一段艰难的时期。

title: Software stocks crushed chips in August. History says September gets tougher: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 软件股在八月份压垮了筹码。历史表明九月变得更加艰难：每日图表
summary: Software stocks just posted their second-best month since 2002 as chip stocks only held on to small gains.
summary_zh: 软件股刚刚创下自 2002 年以来第二好的月份表现，而芯片股仅保持小幅上涨。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq drop as rising bond yields, oil prices weigh on stocks
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数因债券收益率上升而下跌，油价打压股市
summary: Stocks closed out August with solid gains and are now entering their historically weakest month.
summary_zh: 股市在 8 月份收盘时录得强劲上涨，目前正进入历史上最疲软的月份。

title: Rewind to 2011: Tim Cook's first Apple product launch as CEO
title_zh: 时间倒回 2011 年：蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 作为首席执行官推出首款苹果产品
summary: Tim Cook's first product launch as Apple's (AAPL) CEO on Oct. 4, 2011, featured the unveiling of the iPhone 4s and the debut of Siri.
summary_zh: 2011 年 10 月 4 日，蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 作为苹果 (AAPL) 首席执行官首次推出产品，其中包括 iPhone 4s 的发布和 Siri 的首次亮相。

title: Here comes the AI capex shocker, Goldman Sachs says
title_zh: 高盛表示，人工智能资本支出令人震惊
summary: Big spending on AI is poised to continue well into 2027.
summary_zh: 人工智能方面的巨额支出预计将持续到 2027 年。

title: What Nvidia's stellar Q2 earnings represent for AI in the rest of 2026
title_zh: Nvidia 第二季度的出色盈利对 2026 年剩余时间的人工智能意味着什么
summary: After a huge earnings season for Big Tech capped off with blowout second quarter results from Nvidia (NVDA), LPL Financial chief technical strategist Adam Turnquist weighs in on what this could mean for the AI narrative in the second half of 2026.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 的第二季度业绩井喷，为大型科技公司带来了巨大的财报季，LPL Financial 首席技术策略师 Adam Turnquist 对此发表了评论，探讨这对 2026 年下半年人工智能的影响。

title: Tech stocks today: Apple stock slips as Tim Cook prepares to step down
title_zh: 今日科技股：蒂姆·库克准备辞职，苹果股价下跌
summary: It's a momentous day for Apple as CEO Tim Cook prepares to step down.
summary_zh: 对于苹果公司来说，这是一个重要的日子，因为首席执行官蒂姆·库克准备辞职。
